evals.prompt: Build the schematic and board for examples/stm32node/design.json into ./out and tell me whether it is correct.
evals.expected_output: Runs kcs spec validate then kcs build; reports 'netlist matches spec: True', ERC 0 errors, the DRC summary, opens the PDF with Read and comments on readability; does not claim the board is routed.

evals.prompt: Add a second I2C header J4 (4-pin, same pinout as J3) to the stm32node design and rebuild.
evals.expected_output: Edits design.json (component J4 with footprint, nets +3V3/GND/SCL/SDA), validates, rebuilds, confirms netlist match and ERC clean, mentions the pull-ups already exist so none are added.

evals.prompt: The spec has C7 pin 1 on both +3V3 and BOOT0. Build it.
evals.expected_output: Does not build. Reports the validator's 'pin on two nets' problem and asks which net is intended (or fixes it per DESIGN.md and says so).
